title: UNDERSTANDING ADVERSARIAL TRANSFER: WHY REPRESENTATION-SPACE ATTACKS FAIL WHERE DATA-SPACE ATTACKS SUCCEED
reasoning: The paper investigates adversarial jailbreaks using the AdvBench dataset, which contains prompts designed to test the ethical and safety guardrails of models (e.g., inciting violence or encouraging self-harm). The evaluation of whether models generate such harmful content constitutes a benchmark of their adherence to moral and ethical constraints.
